title: Strategy family (L1) — a family of therapeutic approaches
_role: Every ST-* validates against this. L1 partitions the route register: every route lands in exactly one family, and the checker enforces both directions.

thesis.description: The one-sentence bet this family makes about how to treat the disease. If two families share a thesis they are one family.

portfolio_role.description: Why this family is in the portfolio at all. `hedge` matters most: a family whose value is that it retires a blocker the others cannot is worth keeping even when every route in it grades below the best-worked one. ⚠ `lead` IS CURRENTLY CARRIED BY NO FAMILY, AND THAT IS A FINDING RATHER THAN AN OMISSION (trimcrae, 2026-08-06): ST-PROXIMITY held it until the degrader path was taken far enough to hit its blockers, and nothing was promoted in its place because nothing has earned it. The value stays in the enum so a future promotion is expressible — but a portfolio with no lead is a real and honest state, and inventing one to fill the slot would be the over-claim this vocabulary exists to prevent. Superseded, retained: this description's earlier phrasing 'a blocker the LEAD FAMILY cannot' and 'below the LEAD', which silently assumed a lead exists.

routes.description: DERIVED from each route's `strategy` field, never typed. A family listing a route that does not claim it is an error in both directions.

shared_blockers.description: DERIVED: blockers inherited by EVERY route in the family. These are the family-level bets -- if one of these is never retired, the whole family is dead, and that is a different risk from any single route failing.

distinguishing_blockers.description: DERIVED: blockers this family RETIRES that others inherit. This is what the family buys the portfolio.

summary_state.description: DERIVED counts for the L1 view. Never typed -- a hand-carried count drifts the moment a route changes.
